title: Fibonacci EA v5.0 Take-Profit 1 Rebalancing Test
research_question: Does widening InpTP1Pips from 10.0 to 15.0 pips to match InpMaxSLPips (15.0 pips) improve expected payoff and net profitability above baseline EXP-0008 while keeping maximum equity drawdown within 8.0% on GBPUSD M15?
hypothesis: Increasing InpTP1Pips from 10.0 to 15.0 pips establishes a true 1:1 initial risk-reward profile on the first 50% position scale-out, which will increase the average profit per winning trade above $26.59 and lift total net profit above the baseline $577.65, while maximum equity drawdown remains within the 8.0% prop firm guard limit.

facts: EXP-0008 recorded 97 trades with $577.65 net profit, 1.39 profit factor, and 7.35% max equity drawdown under InpDirection=2.
EXP-0008 recorded an average loss of -$73.50 versus an average win of +$26.59 (2.76x loss-to-win asymmetry) with InpTP1Pips=10.0 and InpMaxSLPips=15.0.
inferences: Taking 50% of the trade off at 10 pips truncates upside potential on valid Fibonacci extension runs while risking 15 pips on failures.
A 1:1 initial target (15 pips) before trailing the remainder to 30 pips will raise average trade profitability without significantly degrading the 79% win rate.
evidence: EXP-0008 average_profit_trade=26.59, average_loss_trade=-73.50, profit_factor=1.39, total_net_profit=577.65, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=7.35

independent_variables.name: InpTP1Pips
independent_variables.rationale: Align initial TP1 target with initial SL (15 pips) for a balanced 1:1 risk-reward on the first scale-out.

assumptions: GBPUSD M15 retracements frequently reach at least 15 pips before reversing.
Trailing stop mechanics function identically after reaching the widened 15-pip target.
expected_observations: Average profit per winning trade will increase from $26.59 to at least $30.00.
Total net profit will exceed the baseline $577.65.
falsification_conditions: Total net profit drops below baseline $577.65.
Max equity drawdown exceeds 8.0%, violating the prop firm guard.
